text:
Jordan: Hey team — moving apartments this weekend and need to rehome my 27in ultra-wide monitor (LG, 2560x1080). Works perfectly, VESA mount compatible, some light scratches on the bezel. Asking $60 or free to anyone who can pick up from the SF office by Friday evening. Photos: https://imgur.com/uwide27

Maya: Interested! Does it come with the stand?

Jordan: Stand included. Also have the original box but no HDMI cable.

Noah: If Maya passes, happy to take it off your hands. Can pick up Friday after 5:30pm.

Maya: Can confirm I can pick up Friday at 5pm. Will DM you for a cell number.

FacilitiesBot: Heads up: deliveries and pickups after 6pm require a facilities escort. Please coordinate with Facilities in #eng-infra if pickup is after hours.

Jordan: Good call — I'll drop it by storage locker C today and label it "For Maya". Will also leave a note with pickup instructions.

Lena: Quick PSA: If someone's hauling a monitor across floors, please use the freight elevator and pallet straps. We had a near miss last month.

Maya: Got it, thanks Lena. Bringing a friend to help carry.

Noah: If Maya can't make it, I'm still in the backup queue. Thanks for sharing, Jordan.

Jordan: Sweet. Whoever grabs it, enjoy the ultrawide! If no takers by Friday, I'll post here again and try selling locally. :slightly_smiling_face:

Maya: Claimed — pick up confirmed. DM sent.

Noah: Excellent, congrats Maya!

Jordan: Ticket closed. Thanks everyone.

(Reaction: Jordan's message got :zap: from Maya)
